timeline.text: Deciding what free sample to offer a business meant opening its website and every social page by hand, guessing how much content it had, and writing a prompt from scratch each time.
A Node.js crawler now covers its whole web presence — site and socials together.
Four AI agents take it from there — looking, analyzing, writing, reviewing.
Less guesswork, more an assembly line that checks its own work.
And it now runs three businesses at once, not just one.
